race.description: Spring Carnival Packages On Sale Now Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: BESSIE LA BELLE (5) defeated a handy field first-up here, then thrown in the deep end with a tiring eighth over 1200m at Sandown-Lakeside in BM66 class. Has further upside in this grade and saves her best for this course and distance. Sure to go well. JUSTENUFFSPLASH (10) turned in a nice effort to win on resumption at Wagga, then sent to town with a dismal eighth over 1200m at Sandown-Lakeside. Blinkers go on and no shock to see her return to winning form. TORI'S DEE (2) wasn't disgraced in city class last time when he sat on the speed to run sixth at Sandown-Lakeside. Winning apprentice hops back aboard and he looks to get a better set-up today. NARCISSIST (3) progressed nicely third-up when he griped on late to run second over 1000m at Narrandera. Will appreciate the claim with the big weight. Will be in this for a long way.
